response.sql: WITH large_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, o.amount FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802), group_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, region, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM large_orders GROUP BY account_id, region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM group_avgs) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM group_avgs g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10;
